---
name: Task
about: A deliverable group inside a phase. Not for micro tasks.
title: "Phase N: "
labels: ["unverified"]
---

## Deliverable

What exists when this is done, in one or two sentences.

## Spec

Digest file and section, for example `docs/spec/clock-timing.md`, "Wired side".

## Done when

- [ ] The measurable condition from the plan
- [ ] L0 to L3 tests are in the same commits as the code
- [ ] Claims touched are listed in `docs/ai/CLAIMS.md`
- [ ] `docs/ai/STATE.md` is updated

## Needs from the owner

Human-queue items (H-NNN) or hardware test cards (T-NNN), or "nothing".
